blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Former Department of Public Works and Highways chief Vince Dizon on Tuesday turned over to his successor documents of DPWH personnel linked to corruption. Dizon on Monday was reassigned as transportation secretary, replacing Giovanni Lopez, who in turn took over Dizon’s DPWH top post. During the DPWH turnover ceremony, Dizon handed Lopez a thick pile of documents of DPWH personnel linked to irregularities. “Ikaw na bahala sa mga yan, tanggalin mo na yan in the next few weeks. Reviewin mo na lang. Yan po yung mga susunod. Sorry, gano’n talaga; we have to get rid of the rotten apples […]... Keep on reading: Dizon to Lopez: Your turn to get rid of corrupt DPWH personnel
